changes: Kept the original fiscal-year start at 1993 and extended the analysis endpoint from 2000 to 2005. Rebuilt historical and added rows together, recalculating the accepted pooled complete-case 1st/99th percentile screens on the joint window.

Extended COMP.FUNDA input through fyear 2008 for the 2005 t+3 earnings, CFO, accrual, and return inputs; extended accrual fits through 2005, and the exact-date FX and CRSP daily/name/link bounds through December 2009. The verified source coverage supports the full requested endpoint.

Kept fyear in the existing SAS-to-Stata handoff and added counts from Stata's active e(sample), split at the original 2000 endpoint. The original pooled OLS equation, regressors, screens, transformations, currency conversion, link rules, and conventional standard errors are unchanged.
limitations: The paper specifies the 2004 Compustat combined-industrial vintage; it is unavailable locally. The replay uses the verified current COMP.FUNDA local vintage with the accepted product filters and mappings, so population differences remain possible.

The paper does not fully specify its primary sample screens, exact stock-return source/date convention, percentile scaling/pooling, or pooled OLS covariance correction. The accepted best-effort rules are retained, including conventional OLS standard errors and the requirement for complete linked CRSP session coverage for each annual return.

The fresh pooled current-vintage fit has 21,309 firm-years versus the paper's reported 17,019; the previous accepted reconstruction had 12,712. These are different achieved populations, and the joint extended-window percentile cutoffs are recomputed as required by the accepted construction.
